headline: State Bank of Vietnam Sets Reference Exchange Rate at Record High
summary: The State Bank of Vietnam adjusted its daily central reference exchange rate upward by 13 dong to a record 25,652 VND per US dollar on Tuesday, responding to persistent greenback strength in international currency markets.
why: The State Bank of Vietnam sets a daily reference rate from which commercial banks trade within a set band, balancing export competitiveness against imported inflation.

impacts.name: Vietnamese Dong
impacts.why: The central bank raised the reference midpoint, allowing further depreciation of the dong against the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The central bank raised the official reference rate to a new record high to accommodate broad global dollar strength.
